title: Giraffe dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='93' rx='30' ry='4' fill='#3a2a55'/>
  <!-- back legs dancing -->
  <rect x='60' y='66' width='7' height='22' rx='3' fill='#c98a2e'/>
  <rect x='60' y='66' width='7' height='22' rx='3' fill='#e8b04a' opacity='0.5'/>
  <rect x='66' y='84' width='12' height='6' rx='3' fill='#8a5a1e'/>
  <!-- back leg spots -->
  <circle cx='63' cy='72' r='2' fill='#8a5a1e'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='80' r='2' fill='#8a5a1e'/>
  <!-- front legs dancing -->
  <rect x='33' y='58' width='7' height='26' rx='3' fill='#f5c96b' transform='rotate(-18 36 70)'/>
  <rect x='45' y='62' width='7' height='24' rx='3' fill='#f5c96b'/>
  <rect x='45' y='62' width='7' height='24' rx='3' fill='#ffe08a' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='82' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#8a5a1e' transform='rotate(-18 27 82)'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='85' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#8a5a1e'/>
  <!-- front leg spots -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='66' r='2' fill='#8a5a1e'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='72' r='2' fill='#8a5a1e'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='17' ry='12' fill='#f5c96b'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='52' r='3' fill='#8a5a1e'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='58' r='3' fill='#8a5a1e'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='51' r='2.5' fill='#8a5a1e'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M38 50 Q30 32 36 18 L46 18 Q42 32 48 50 Z' fill='#f5c96b'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='42' r='2.5' fill='#8a5a1e'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='33' r='2.5' fill='#8a5a1e'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='25' r='2.5' fill='#8a5a1e'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='16' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#f5c96b'/>
  <!-- ossicones -->
  <line x1='38' y1='9' x2='36' y2='3' stroke='#e8b04a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='9' x2='48' y2='3' stroke='#e8b04a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='3' r='2.5' fill='#ff9d3a'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='3' r='2.5' fill='#ff9d3a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='12' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#e8b04a' transform='rotate(-20 32 12)'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='12' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#e8b04a' transform='rotate(20 52 12)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='51' cy='18' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#ffb66b'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='17' r='1' fill='#7a4a12'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='14' r='2' fill='#3a2a55'/>
  <circle cx='44.7' cy='13.3' r='0.7' fill='#fff2c8'/>
  <!-- smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M47 20 Q50 22.5 53 20' stroke='#7a4a12' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- dancing arm/flourish (front) -->
  <path d='M36 44 Q28 40 24 32' stroke='#f5c96b' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='23' cy='31' r='3' fill='#e8b04a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M67 50 Q76 48 74 42' stroke='#c98a2e' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='41' r='3' fill='#8a5a1e'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill='#8fd6ff'>
    <circle cx='82' cy='26' r='3.5'/>
    <rect x='84.5' y='14' width='2' height='13' fill='#8fd6ff'/>
    <circle cx='68' cy='20' r='3'/>
    <rect x='70.2' y='9' width='2' height='12' fill='#8fd6ff'/>
  </g>
</svg>
